newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Dec 1996 value of production index up.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Dec 1996 value of production index up.

text.p: The Philippines' value of production index rose by 0.6 percent year-on-year in December 1996 to 418.6 from 416.1, the National Statistics Office said on Wednesday.
But the volume of production index showed a year-on-year decline of 2.6 percent in December to 140.4 compared with 144.1 last year, the agency said.
The volume of production index measures change in volume, net of inflation.
On a month-on-month basis, the value of production index slipped by 2.9 percent from November's 431.2. Volume of production index fell 3.8 percent from 145.9, the agency said.
Year-on-year increases in value were experienced in nine major sectors, which were led by industries linked to construction activities, the agency said.
Furniture and fixtures posted the highest increase at 23.3 percent. This was followed by non-metallic mineral products such as glass products which had a growth rate of 21.9 percent.
The other leading sectors were beverage, 10.6 percent; tobacco, 9.4 percent; basic metals, 9.1 percent; and wood and wood products, 7.9 percent.
However, the volume of production index was pulled down by double-digit decreases in four sectors. Wearing apparel posted biggest year-on-year decline of 28.8 percent.
Textiles fell by 21.4 percent; rubber products, 20.4 percent; and non-ferrous metals, 20.3 percent, the agency said.
